SY382
Social Statistics
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
A variety of statistical techniques for analyzing survey research will be considered including cross-tabular analysis, correlation and regression. The emphasis will be on descriptive statistics with an introduction to inferential statistics.
Additional Course Information
Prerequisites
SY101
,
SY280
.
Exclusions
SY236.
